name: HELM Capabilities benchmark metric scope
description: Published benchmark edition with its own identity, separate from the HELM framework package. Active denotes available methodology, not a maintenance or fitness guarantee. This is a source-only capability proposal. No evaluation, dataset admission, model/data permission, price quote or deployment gate is established. See research/T6-deployment-operations/evaluation.md.

provenance.notes: The published 1.0.0 suite uses multiple-choice scoring for MMLU-Pro and GPQA, strict IFEval scoring, a rescaled WildBench judge average, and Omni-MATH judge accuracy. These labels describe distinct policies; neither loose IFEval scoring nor one universal judge is implied. The fixed benchmark workflow supports offline mode, while configured judges can require external services.

The current HELM maintenance policy is best-effort maintenance, not a promise of feature development. It does not establish that this published benchmark was retired. Framework package 0.5.16 and benchmark 1.0.0 are different version identities.
